Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
menu
Yes, damaged items are handled differently from standard returns.
For standard returns, items are sent back to us (with return shipping managed by the customer) for store credit. For damaged items, our team processes a replacement order for you as soon as possible.
If you'd like us to set up a replacement for your damaged item, please tap the Contact Support button below to reach out to our team.
Contact support

If you'd like us to get your replacement started, please tap the Contact Support button below to connect with our support team.
